title: backlog.py stage-back ID copies a headless worker's .claude/ staging copies into its worktree, checks and commits them
goal: Retrospective of SP-sbdy4hsx: every code story touched .claude/ files, so the orchestrator copied each worker's staging copies back by hand (13 files over 4 items), ran selfdoc.py check and the item's checks there, and wrote a second commit with Self-Reviewed for each. backlog.py stage-back ID copies the staging copies dispatch named into the worker's worktree, refuses a copy whose base differs from the worktree's file, runs selfdoc.py check and the item's own checks there, and commits the copies alone with KB-Work on work/ID; the kb-sprint skill's run step 3 names it; a test stages a planted copy and finds one new commit holding only it.
notes: SP-etslk6yu close evidence: ST-f2n2h22c's kb-census and kb-refresh SKILL.md staging copies were copied back, checked and committed by hand once more. Merged from ST-v5fdysq2 “A headless worker checks its .claude/ staging copies with selfdoc.py check before it returns” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: near-duplicate (0.89) of ST-5z4e6z4i: its stage-back runs selfdoc.py check on the staged copies; selfdoc.py check takes no staging option today. Carrier must absorb: the worker's report names problems=0 for what it staged Its goal: A headless worker edits .claude/ files only as staging copies under its _cache/scratch/<id>/staging/, and selfdoc.py check in its worktree reads the unchanged originals, so a dead heading reference in a staged copy reaches the orchestrator: in SP-qg7ncs6d the ST-nlxo2zv5 worker's staged kb-verify step 5 cited (kb/_self/backlog.md, Working on items, One suite), a heading that does not exist, and only the orchestrator's copy-back check caught it (SP-pbekfhaz had the same). The worker can run the docs check over its staging copies (a selfdoc.py check option that reads the staged files in place of the worktree's, or the brief's command for it), so its report names problems=0 for what it staged. Found at the SP-qg7ncs6d close. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/selfdoc.py','check','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True);ok=r.returncode==0 and 'staging' in r.stdout;print('selfdoc check reads staging copies:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"]} Its touches: _tools/selfdoc.py, _tools/bl_dispatch.py, .claude/agents/kb-worker.md, kb/_self/tools.md, kb/_self/code.md, kb/_self/backlog.md, kb/_self/plugin.md, kb/_self/token-efficiency.md Recurred in SP-htl7jkrm: a hand copy-back without Self-Reviewed stopped ST-65r3cwix's land at step stale; ST-qigkeiv3 and BG-6ecranz3 needed the same copy-back.
